dataset: manu/eli5_authorship_attribution (eli5_authors.csv, sampled, comments concatenated to approximate assignment-length documents)
note: This signal is intentionally weighted lowest of the three in RiskFusionModel's default weights - it's a real but noisier signal than semantic similarity or AI-text detection, used as corroborating evidence (esp. for ghostwriting, which the other two signals structurally cannot catch) rather than a standalone detector.
